What’s been on your mind lately that you’d like to talk about today?

I don’t know… I guess I’ve been carrying this worry around like a weight lately. I mean, I’ve been using THC edibles for a year—just small doses, 20 to 50mg—mostly to help with stress and sleep, but after reading those articles about heart risks, I just started panicking. I didn’t even realize how much I’d relied on it until I stopped. And now, every time I think about going back, my chest tightens like I’m having that anxiety attack again. I went to the hospital last month, just to be safe—everything came back normal, but it still feels like I’m walking on eggshells. I don’t know if I’m being too scared, or if I’m just… not sure what to believe anymore.

I just don’t know how to trust my body anymore—or whether I’m being too hard on myself.

I just feel so caught between wanting relief and being afraid I’m putting myself at risk. I don’t want to be dependent on anything, but I also don’t want to live with this constant anxiety either. It’s like I’m trying to balance two things that don’t feel real—like one is a dream and the other is a warning. I don’t know if I can trust my body to handle it again, or if I’m just scared because I’ve been using it so long. It’s making me feel small, like I’m making a choice that could change everything—without really knowing what I’m doing.

I just feel so small right now—like I’m making a decision that could change my life, but I don’t have a clear sense of what I’m actually trying to protect. I want to feel calm, but I’m afraid that if I go back, I’ll be putting myself in danger. And if I don’t, I feel like I’m losing the only thing that’s ever really helped me feel grounded.
